issues.description: The intended ordering of arguments for correct_teleportation (teleportation_measurements, x_measurements) as specified in the problem statement and template is inconsistent with how the function is called in the solution. In the solution the arrays are passed in reversed order (x_measurements, teleportation_measurements) when invoking correct_teleportation. This mismatch between the declared parameter semantics and actual usage is likely to confuse students and cause incorrect behavior if they follow the problem statement/template ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter order and semantics consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement/template to document correct_teleportation as correct_teleportation(x_measurements, teleportation_measurements) if callers should pass (final, tele), or (B) update the solution call sites to pass the arguments in the declared order (teleportation_measurements, x_measurements). Prefer the latter to match the current function signature: call correct_teleportation(measurements[:, tele], measurements[:, final]) and similarly for all other uses.
